subject: Enabling the Usage Bridge: mapping SaaS entitlements to AWS Marketplace metering — next steps
messages:
From: Paula Green <paula.green@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mapping our seat & feature entitlements to AWS metering dimensions

Hi Monica / Karthik —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're prepping to list Acme Health's CareSuite on AWS Marketplace and hit a snag reconciling our internal entitlement model (seat tiers + optional connectors) with the Marketplace metering dimensions.

What we'd like from Redwood: a simple mapping template and a short checklist of fulfillment steps so we can coordinate legal (amendment) and engineering (webhook + event schema). Attached: a small export of our entitlement table (acme-entitlement-mapping.csv).

Questions:
- Do we need a DOI/amendment before metering can be enabled, or can we do a canary without signed paperwork?
- Which usage dimensions do you recommend for combined seat + connector billing so we avoid double-charging?

We're aiming to go live with a limited subset (pilot customers) mid-May. Any chance you can turn around a recommended mapping by end of next week?

Thanks,
Paula Green
Head of Partnerships, Acme Health
paula.green@acmehealth.com
[Attachment: acme-entitlement-mapping.csv]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Paula Green <paula.green@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping our seat & feature entitlements to AWS metering dimensions

Paula —

Appreciate the export. We've reviewed the CSV and can absolutely help map this to a Marketplace-friendly schema. High level plan below (quick):

1) Mapping template (deliverable): we will return a filled mapping CSV that shows entitlement -> usage dimension(s) and a preferred aggregation key (customer_id + product_sku).
2) Metering integration: recommend two dimensions — seats (integer) and connectors (metered unit). We suggest reporting seats as an aggregated daily gauge and connectors as an incrementing counter per activation.
3) Fulfillment/contract: Marketplace requires a signed amendment for SaaS Fulfillment in most cases; however, we can spin up a pilot with reduced scope if legal signs a minimal amendment.
4) Timeline & owners: technical mapping (Karthik) by 2027-04-12, legal amendment draft (Laura) by 2027-04-14, ops webhook verification once amendment is signed.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm pilot SKUs and which customers to include (list of account IDs)
- Share sample usage events (JSON payload) or allow Redwood test events to be accepted in sandbox

I'll attach our mapping template and a checklist. Can we schedule a 30-minute pass-through tomorrow so Karthik can confirm the event schema?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-entitlement-mapping-template.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Paula Green <paula.green@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping our seat & feature entitlements to AWS metering dimensions

Paula / Monica —

Following up with the technical mapping and a few pragmatic notes after I ran the CSV through our template. See attached: a filled mapping (acme-entitlement-mapping.csv) and a short spec for the fulfillment webhook (marketplace-webhook-spec.md). Key points:

- Dimensions: use "acme_seats" (daily gauge) and "acme_connectors" (incremental). For optional add-ons, map to separate dimensions rather than embed in seat count to make reconciliation clear.
- Aggregation key: recommend customer_uuid + aws_account_id as the canonical key in reported events. This prevents duplicate attribution when accounts span multiple Marketplace buyers.
- Backfill & proration: if entitlement changes mid-billing-cycle, report a prorated seat delta event and include a metadata field "proration_window_start". Redwood's billing reconciliation can consume these deltas.
- Security: sign webhook requests with HMAC header and rotate keys monthly. We'll provide a temporary sandbox key.
- Fulfillment/legal: marketplace typically requires a signed SaaS amendment to enable production metering. For pilot, we can enable sandbox metering without DocuSign, but production metering must be wired after amendment.

Attachments: acme-entitlement-mapping.csv (filled), marketplace-webhook-spec.md (attachment stub). I'll open a ticket with AWS Ops to confirm the dimension names; copying their address below.

AWS Ops contact: marketplace-ops@amazon.com (we'll include them if you want Redwood to coordinate).

If that looks good Paula, we can schedule the webhook test on Wed afternoon.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachments: acme-entitlement-mapping.csv, marketplace-webhook-spec.md]

From: Paula Green <paula.green@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping our seat & feature entitlements to AWS metering dimensions

Monica / Karthik —

This looks great, thank you. Laura's legal team and ours spoke this morning; we routed the SaaS amendment to DocuSign and I uploaded the signed PDF here (attached). A few follow-ups from our side:

- Signed amendment attached: signed-saas-amendment.pdf. Please confirm when production metering is enabled or if you need anything else from legal.
- Proration question: Acme will bill customers monthly on calendar dates; if we report prorated deltas, will Redwood reconcile automatically to a net usage figure for the customer invoice? We want to avoid issuing manual credits.
- Pilot scope: start with 10 pilot accounts (list sent separately). We'll want the webhook active in sandbox tomorrow and production once you confirm the amendment.

If AWS Ops (cc) needs anything from our side to finalize dimensions, let me know — happy to loop our cloud procurement contact.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/StartInPersonSigning.aspx?envelopeId=0XYZ
Marketplace ticket: MP-89212 (created by Acme).

Thanks again — let's aim to validate sandbox events tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Paula Green
Head of Partnerships, Acme Health
paula.green@acmehealth.com
[Attachment: signed-saas-amendment.pdf]
